root_cause: Concurrent Company Brain and AI Modelwijzer changes were merged on moving main epochs. Production therefore built a combination that had not been re-proven as one exact candidate, exposing post-transform static-English cache gaps after merge.
prevention: Re-prove the exact current-main combination after concurrent public-site changes.
Keep exact post-transform translation fragments in the canonical static cache.
Supersede stale recovery PRs rather than merging them across a moved main epoch.
fix: Apply the exact Company Brain fragment translations on current main and run the canonical premerge production-build parity before the next production promotion.
